Flooring Calculator

Estimate flooring material with waste allowance: boxes needed, total area and cost for any room.

–

–

Boxes are rounded up. Buy whole boxes only — stores do not split them.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the room length and width in feet.
  2. Set the waste percentage (10% is standard, 15% for diagonal layouts).
  3. Enter your box coverage and optional price per box to get boxes and cost.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why add waste?

Cuts around edges, doorways and closets consume material, and you need spare planks or tiles for future repairs. 10% covers most straight layouts.

Where do I find box coverage?

It is printed on the flooring box as "coverage" or "sq ft per carton", commonly 15-25 sq ft.

Should I measure in feet or meters?

This tool uses feet. Multiply meters by 3.281 to convert before entering.
